25/*
26 * <p>MaxiCodes can encode text or structured information as bits in one of several modes,
27 * with multiple character sets in one code. This class decodes the bits back into text.</p>
28 *
29 * @author mike32767
30 * @author Manuel Kasten
31 */

33const SHIFTA: &str = "\u{FFF0}";
34const SHIFTB: &str = "\u{FFF1}";
35const SHIFTC: &str = "\u{FFF2}";
36const SHIFTD: &str = "\u{FFF3}";
37const SHIFTE: &str = "\u{FFF4}";
38const TWOSHIFTA: &str = "\u{FFF5}";
39const THREESHIFTA: &str = "\u{FFF6}";
40const LATCHA: &str = "\u{FFF7}";
41const LATCHB: &str = "\u{FFF8}";
42const LOCK: &str = "\u{FFF9}";
43const ECI: &str = "\u{FFFA}";
44const NS: &str = "\u{FFFB}";
45const PAD: &str = "\u{FFFC}";
46const FS: &str = "\u{001C}";
47const GS: &str = "\u{001D}";
48const RS: &str = "\u{001E}";
49const COUNTRY_BYTES: [u8; 10] = [53, 54, 43, 44, 45, 46, 47, 48, 37, 38];
50const SERVICE_CLASS_BYTES: [u8; 10] = [55, 56, 57, 58, 59, 60, 49, 50, 51, 52];
51const POSTCODE_2_LENGTH_BYTES: [u8; 6] = [39, 40, 41, 42, 31, 32];
52const POSTCODE_2_BYTES: [u8; 30] = [
53    33, 34, 35, 36, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 7, 8,
54    9, 10, 11, 12, 1, 2,
55];
56const POSTCODE_3_BYTES: [[u8; 6]; 6] = [
57    [39, 40, 41, 42, 31, 32],
58    [33, 34, 35, 36, 25, 26],
59    [27, 28, 29, 30, 19, 20],
60    [21, 22, 23, 24, 13, 14],
61    [15, 16, 17, 18, 7, 8],
62    [9, 10, 11, 12, 1, 2],
63];

65static SETS: Lazy<[String; 5]> = Lazy::new(|| {
66    [
67    format!("\rABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ{ECI}{FS}{GS}{RS}{NS} {PAD}\"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:{SHIFTB}{SHIFTC}{SHIFTD}{SHIFTE}{LATCHB}"           ),
68    format!("`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{ECI}{FS}{GS}{RS}{NS}{{{PAD}}}~\u{007F};<=>?[\\]^_ ,./:@!|{PAD}{TWOSHIFTA}{THREESHIFTA}{PAD}{SHIFTA}{SHIFTC}{SHIFTD}{SHIFTE}{LATCHA}"               ),
69        format!("\u{00C0}\u{00C1}\u{00C2}\u{00C3}\u{00C4}\u{00C5}\u{00C6}\u{00C7}\u{00C8}\u{00C9}\u{00CA}\u{00CB}\u{00CC}\u{00CD}\u{00CE}\u{00CF}\u{00D0}\u{00D1}\u{00D2}\u{00D3}\u{00D4}\u{00D5}\u{00D6}\u{00D7}\u{00D8}\u{00D9}\u{00DA}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}" ,
70        ECI , FS , GS , RS , NS ,
71        "\u{00DB}\u{00DC}\u{00DD}\u{00DE}\u{00DF}\u{00AA}\u{00AC}\u{00B1}\u{00B2}\u{00B3}\u{00B5}\u{00B9}\u{00BA}\u{00BC}\u{00BD}\u{00BE}\u{0080}\u{0081}\u{0082}\u{0083}\u{0084}\u{0085}\u{0086}\u{0087}\u{0088}\u{0089}" ,
72        LATCHA , ' ' , LOCK , SHIFTD , SHIFTE , LATCHB),
73    format!("\u{00E0}\u{00E1}\u{00E2}\u{00E3}\u{00E4}\u{00E5}\u{00E6}\u{00E7}\u{00E8}\u{00E9}\u{00EA}\u{00EB}\u{00EC}\u{00ED}\u{00EE}\u{00EF}\u{00F0}\u{00F1}\u{00F2}\u{00F3}\u{00F4}\u{00F5}\u{00F6}\u{00F7}\u{00F8}\u{00F9}\u{00FA}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}" ,
74        ECI , FS , GS , RS , NS ,
75        "\u{00FB}\u{00FC}\u{00FD}\u{00FE}\u{00FF}\u{00A1}\u{00A8}\u{00AB}\u{00AF}\u{00B0}\u{00B4}\u{00B7}\u{00B8}\u{00BB}\u{00BF}\u{008A}\u{008B}\u{008C}\u{008D}\u{008E}\u{008F}\u{0090}\u{0091}\u{0092}\u{0093}\u{0094}" ,
76        LATCHA , ' ' , SHIFTC , LOCK , SHIFTE , LATCHB),
77    format!("\u{0000}\u{0001}\u{0002}\u{0003}\u{0004}\u{0005}\u{0006}\u{0007}\u{0008}\u{0009}\n\u{000B}\u{000C}\r\u{000E}\u{000F}\u{0010}\u{0011}\u{0012}\u{0013}\u{0014}\u{0015}\u{0016}\u{0017}\u{0018}\u{0019}\u{001A}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}{}" ,
78        ECI , PAD , PAD , '\u{001B}' , NS , FS , GS , RS ,
79        "\u{001F}\u{009F}\u{00A0}\u{00A2}\u{00A3}\u{00A4}\u{00A5}\u{00A6}\u{00A7}\u{00A9}\u{00AD}\u{00AE}\u{00B6}\u{0095}\u{0096}\u{0097}\u{0098}\u{0099}\u{009A}\u{009B}\u{009C}\u{009D}\u{009E}" ,
80        LATCHA , ' ' , SHIFTC , SHIFTD , LOCK , LATCHB),
81   ]
82});

84static GRAPHEME_SETS: Lazy<[Vec<&str>; 5]> = Lazy::new(|| {
85    [
86        SETS[0].graphemes(true).collect(),
87        SETS[1].graphemes(true).collect(),
88        SETS[2].graphemes(true).collect(),
89        SETS[3].graphemes(true).collect(),
90        SETS[4].graphemes(true).collect(),
91    ]
92});

94pub fn decode(bytes: &[u8], mode: u8) -> Result<DecoderRXingResult> {
95    let mut result = String::with_capacity(144);
96    match mode {
97        2 | 3 => {
98            let postcode = if mode == 2 {
99                let pc = getPostCode2(bytes);
100                let ps2Length = getPostCode2Length(bytes) as usize;
101                if ps2Length > 10 {
102                    return Err(Exceptions::FORMAT);
103                }
104                // NumberFormat df = new DecimalFormat("0000000000".substring(0, ps2Length));
105                // postcode = df.format(pc);
106                format!("{pc:0>ps2Length$}")
107            } else {
108                getPostCode3(bytes)
109            };
110            // NumberFormat threeDigits = new DecimalFormat("000");
111            // let country = threeDigits.format(getCountry(bytes));
112            // let service = threeDigits.format(getServiceClass(bytes));
113            let country = format!("{:0>3}", getCountry(bytes)); //threeDigits.format(getCountry(bytes));
114            let service = format!("{:0>3}", getServiceClass(bytes));
115            result.push_str(&getMessage(bytes, 10, 84));
116            if result.starts_with(&format!("[)>{}{}{}", RS, "01", GS)) {
117                result.insert_str(9, &format!("{postcode}{GS}{country}{GS}{service}{GS}"));
118            } else {
119                result.insert_str(0, &format!("{postcode}{GS}{country}{GS}{service}{GS}"));
120            }
121        }
122        4 => {
123            result.push_str(&getMessage(bytes, 1, 93));
124        }
125        5 => {
126            result.push_str(&getMessage(bytes, 1, 77));
127        }
128        _ => {}
129    }
130    Ok(DecoderRXingResult::new(
131        bytes.to_vec(),
132        result,
133        Vec::new(),
134        mode.to_string(),
135    ))
136}

138fn getBit(bit: u8, bytes: &[u8]) -> u8 {
139    let bit = bit - 1;
140    u8::from((bytes[bit as usize / 6] & (1 << (5 - (bit % 6)))) != 0)
141    // if (bytes[bit as usize / 6] & (1 << (5 - (bit % 6)))) == 0 {
142    //     0
143    // } else {
144    //     1
145    // }
146}
147
148fn getInt(bytes: &[u8], x: &[u8]) -> u32 {
149    let mut val: u32 = 0;
150    for i in 0..x.len() {
151        // for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
152        val += (getBit(x[i], bytes) as u32) << ((x.len() - i - 1) as u32);
153    }
154    val
155}
156
157fn getCountry(bytes: &[u8]) -> u32 {
158    getInt(bytes, &COUNTRY_BYTES)
159}
160
161fn getServiceClass(bytes: &[u8]) -> u32 {
162    getInt(bytes, &SERVICE_CLASS_BYTES)
163}
164
165fn getPostCode2Length(bytes: &[u8]) -> u32 {
166    getInt(bytes, &POSTCODE_2_LENGTH_BYTES)
167}
168
169fn getPostCode2(bytes: &[u8]) -> u32 {
170    getInt(bytes, &POSTCODE_2_BYTES)
171}
172
173fn getPostCode3(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
174    let mut sb = String::with_capacity(POSTCODE_3_BYTES.len());
175    let graphemes = SETS[0].graphemes(true).collect::<Vec<_>>();
176    for p3bytes in &POSTCODE_3_BYTES {
177        if let Some(c) = graphemes.get(getInt(bytes, p3bytes) as usize) {
178            sb.push_str(c);
179        }
180    }
181    sb
182}
183
184fn getMessage(bytes: &[u8], start: u32, len: u32) -> String {
185    let mut sb = String::new();
186    let mut shift = -1;
187    let mut set = 0;
188    let mut lastset = 0;
189
190    let mut i = start;
191    while i < start + len {
192        let Some(c) = GRAPHEME_SETS[set].get(bytes[i as usize] as usize).copied() else {
193            break;
194        };
195        match c {
196            LATCHA => {
197                set = 0;
198                shift = -1;
199            }
200            LATCHB => {
201                set = 1;
202                shift = -1;
203            }
204            SHIFTA | SHIFTB | SHIFTC | SHIFTD | SHIFTE => {
205                lastset = set;
206                // set = c - SHIFTA;
207                set = subtract_two_single_char_strings(c, SHIFTA);
208                shift = 1;
209            }
210            TWOSHIFTA => {
211                lastset = set;
212                set = 0;
213                shift = 2;
214            }
215            THREESHIFTA => {
216                lastset = set;
217                set = 0;
218                shift = 3;
219            }
220            NS => {
221                // let nsval = (bytes[++i] << 24) + (bytes[++i] << 18) + (bytes[++i] << 12) + (bytes[++i] << 6) + bytes[++i];
222                i += 1;
223                let mut nsval = (bytes[i as usize] as u32) << 24;
224                i += 1;
225                nsval += (bytes[i as usize] as u32) << 18;
226                i += 1;
227                nsval += (bytes[i as usize] as u32) << 12;
228                i += 1;
229                nsval += (bytes[i as usize] as u32) << 6;
230                i += 1;
231                nsval += bytes[i as usize] as u32;
232                // sb.append(new DecimalFormat("000000000").format(nsval));},
233                sb.push_str(&format!("{nsval:0>9}"));
234            }
235            LOCK => {
236                shift = -1;
237            }
238            _ => {
239                sb.push_str(c);
240            }
241        }
242        if shift == 0 {
243            set = lastset;
244        }
245        shift -= 1;
246        i += 1;
247    }
248
249    String::from(sb.trim_end_matches(PAD))
250}
251
252fn subtract_two_single_char_strings(str1: &str, str2: &str) -> usize {
253    let str1_bytes = str1.as_bytes();
254    let str2_bytes = str2.as_bytes();
255
256    let str1_u16 =
257        ((str1_bytes[0] as usize) << 4) + ((str1_bytes[1] as usize) << 2) + str1_bytes[2] as usize;
258    let str2_u16 =
259        ((str2_bytes[0] as usize) << 4) + ((str2_bytes[1] as usize) << 2) + str2_bytes[2] as usize;
260
261    str1_u16 - str2_u16
262}
